detail.title: PS431 Power Strip with Individual Switches - Grey
detail.overview: The Ant PS431 is a 10ft universal extension cord featuring 4 AC outlets, 3 USB-A ports and 1 Type-C PD port, letting you power up to 8 devices at once. What sets it apart is a dedicated individual power switch for each outlet, letting you turn off unused sockets to improve safety, save electricity and skip the hassle of constantly plugging and unplugging devices. Built with a 10-foot heavy-duty pure copper cable rated for 10A / 2500W at 220-250V, it handles high-power devices reliably, while wide socket spacing accommodates large power adapters without blocking neighbouring outlets. A practical, safety-conscious extension cord for home, office or retail store use.
